Meanwhile, the beam is accelerated to a higher energy. Figure 13 shows the evolution of the particle distribution of a high intensity beam (13×1011) in phase space during earlier Booster cycle. The purple, blue, green, yellow, brown and red dots represent the phase space distributions at the times (counting from beginning of injection) 1.2msec, 7.2msec, 8.4msec, 9.6msec, 11msec and 12msec, respectively.
